thread:
Anita Rao: Heads-up — did a quick pass on the Prompt Sets bulk-approve flow in the Figma mock. A couple of accessibility and copy nits.
Jordan Kim: +1 can you list the nits? hard to parse the mock at a glance :eyes:
Anita Rao: Main things:
- Confirmation modal copy 'Approve X prompt sets' reads like an action not reversible. We should clarify and offer the rollback path in copy.
- Keyboard focus isn't obvious in the modal — no visible focus ring on the primary CTA when tabbing.
- Screenreader text for the toggles in the bulk list is missing, they announce as 'button' only.
Maya Patel: Oof on the SR text. That's a regression from last release.
Sam Rivera: Do we have the exact modal copy now? I can push a tiny change if we agree.
Anita Rao: Current copy: "Approve 12 prompt sets" with subtext "This action will publish these sets to production." Proposal: "Approve 12 prompt sets — this will publish the selected sets. You can revert within 24 hours from the Prompt Sets history." (shorter alt for mobile: "Publish 12 selected sets. Revert within 24h.")
Jordan Kim: I like the explicit 'revert within 24 hours' — helps product teams feel safer. Also suggest an inline link to 'Prompt Sets history' for context.
Maya Patel: For the focus ring: use our standard accessible focus style (2px high-contrast outline). I'll add token class in the spec.
Sam Rivera: QA Bot, can you run the keyboard navigation tests against the modal once we patch?
QA Bot: Running keyboard-nav regression suite on branch: feature/prompt-bulk-approve-a11y
QA Bot: Tests flagged: "modal-focus-order" and "toggle-aria-labels" failures on Chrome (Mac) and VoiceOver.
Anita Rao: Thanks. Jordan, Maya — can you two align on the microcopy + focus styles? I can update Figma and push the exact strings to the PR.
Jordan Kim: Will do. Quick microcopy question: should we say "revert within 24 hours" or "request a revert within 24 hours"? The latter implies manual intervention.
Maya Patel: 'Revert within 24 hours' seems okay as long as backend supports automated rollback. If it's manual, we must say 'request'. I'll check infra with Sam.
Sam Rivera: Infra: automated rollback exists for publish jobs for the last 24h, but only for exact version match. I'll create a short note in the acceptance criteria.
Anita Rao: Great — acceptance criteria: 1) modal copy updated, 2) focus ring applied to primary and secondary CTAs, 3) toggles have aria-labels reflecting set name and action, 4) link to history present, 5) unit test for keyboard order.
Jordan Kim: Also update the toast copy after approval. Current toast: "Approved" — needs to be "Published 12 prompt sets — Undo" (with Undo action). Tooltip on Undo should explain revert timeline.
Maya Patel: Accessibility nit: the toast Undo must be reachable via keyboard and have aria-live polite region for SRs.
Anita Rao: I'll capture final copy here and drop into the PR description. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxx/prompt-sets-bulk
Sam Rivera: I'll add the infra note and a tiny e2e that hits the rollback endpoint.
QA Bot: Re-run queued tests after PR updates: feature/prompt-bulk-approve-a11y
Jordan Kim: One more UX thought — when users select 100+ sets, modal should show a condensed list and scroll inside the modal, not expand the page.
Maya Patel: Yep — sticky header, internal scroll area.
Anita Rao: Thanks team. I'll push copy + a11y checklist today. Ping here when PR is ready for review :thumbsup:
Jordan Kim: Sounds good. @Sam Rivera please add the rollback acceptance criteria in the PR body so reviewers don't miss it.
Sam Rivera: Done, will add now.
QA Bot: CI queued for feature/prompt-bulk-approve-a11y. Expected feedback in ~15m.
Anita Rao: Awesome — closing loop. If anything else pops up I'll update this thread.
Jordan Kim: Thanks all :heart:
